selection_rule: Select exactly one focal event. Every other visual layer either supports it or releases it.

focal_events.name: Decisive edge crop
focal_events.definition: One object or image fragment is enlarged and cropped by one or more canvas edges.
focal_events.title_behavior: title aligns to the crop or occupies the open counter-space; do not shrink the title to preserve the object
focal_events.release_zone: the broad region opposite the cropped mass
focal_events.thumbnail_test: the cropped object is identifiable before reading the subtitle

focal_events.name: Title / contour tension
focal_events.definition: The title approaches, splits around, or tracks one outer contour of the primary form.
focal_events.title_behavior: glyph silhouettes remain clear; only soft low-contrast atmosphere may pass behind glyphs
focal_events.release_zone: the quiet side of the form and any unused space beside short title lines
focal_events.thumbnail_test: title reads as one dominant block, not scattered labels

focal_events.name: Single scale anomaly
focal_events.definition: One element is intentionally much larger or smaller than expected, creating the memorable event.
focal_events.title_behavior: support type becomes quiet; no second oversized object or display treatment
focal_events.release_zone: one large low-information field around the scale anomaly
focal_events.thumbnail_test: the scale relationship is visible at 25% size

focal_events.name: Repeated object rhythm
focal_events.definition: One object family repeats at varied scale, crop, or angle while one instance owns the focal scale.
focal_events.title_behavior: title lives in a clear open band and touches at most one object contour
focal_events.release_zone: a visibly quieter band with no extra copies or pseudo-data
focal_events.thumbnail_test: the image reads as one family, not a decorative pattern

focal_events.name: Portal entry
focal_events.definition: A title or object is visually drawn toward one opening, threshold, or framed counter-shape.
focal_events.title_behavior: use a shared centerline or tangent; prohibit orbit lines and repeated rings
focal_events.release_zone: inside or beside the opening, kept soft behind the text
focal_events.thumbnail_test: the opening reads as a directional relationship, not a glowing tunnel

focal_events.name: Negative-space cut
focal_events.definition: A pale panel, atmospheric cutout, or exposed field enters the primary mass and creates a shaped quiet zone.
focal_events.title_behavior: place only the approved text elements in the cut; never turn it into a UI card
focal_events.release_zone: the cut itself or the field it opens
focal_events.thumbnail_test: the quiet shape is visible when the text is mentally removed
